_about: Registered data sets (STANDARDS.md section 6). Every document, figure and tool reads these numbers. Quartile convention for all summaries: median of each half, overall median excluded when n is odd (TI-84 1-Var Stats).

lincoln-commute.desc: Journey time to school, minutes, 25 randomly chosen Lincoln High students

test-scores-50.desc: Scores on a test marked out of 50, 24 students (Session 2 homework)

cafe-drinks-hour.desc: Drinks sold per hour over 20 opening hours at a café

wait-st-marys.desc: Minutes from arrival to being seen by a doctor, the 84 surveyed St Mary's patients (hospital survey, Session 1)

wait-riverside.desc: Minutes from arrival to being seen by a doctor, the 71 surveyed Riverside patients

library-items-5.desc: Items borrowed last year by five library members (homework Part C)

library-hours-central.desc: Hours spent in library buildings last year, 35 randomly chosen Central branch members

library-hours-westside.desc: Hours spent in library buildings last year, 30 randomly chosen Westside branch members

match-mine-cards.desc: Histogram counts for the nine Match Mine cards, ten bins of width 10 on 0 to 100, 40 values each

commute-sd-worked.desc: Five of the 25 Lincoln High journeys, the worked by-hand standard deviation example

commute-sd-yourturn.desc: Five of the 25 Lincoln High journeys, the student's by-hand standard deviation

cafe-midday-temp-c.desc: Midday outdoor temperature outside the café on 10 days, degrees Celsius (changing units, C to F)

cafe-fridge-temp-c.desc: Café fridge temperature log, 10 readings, degrees Celsius (homework D3)

oakfield-commute-20.desc: Journey time to school, minutes, 20 randomly chosen Oakfield School students (homework E)

lincoln-distance-time.desc: Distance from school and journey time for the same 25 Lincoln High students (Scenario A). y is the registered lincoln-commute list, in the same order.
lincoln-distance-time.notes: Point (2.5, 33) does not fit the pattern; point (28, 68) is Session 3's outlier and fits it.

lsrl.notes: Session 5 Scenario A. xbar 6.28, sx 6.117, ybar 21.44, sy 13.07. Predictions: 12 km 33.0 (interpolation), 45 km 99.6 (extrapolation). Residuals: (2.5,33) +19.2, (28,68) +2.7, (7,18) -4.9, (5,22) +3.1, (7.5,24) +0.1.

lincoln-distance-time-five.desc: Five of the 25 students, the by-hand r example (journey times are commute-sd-worked). x mean 6, s 5; y mean 20, s 10; sum of z-products 3.84; r = 0.96.

cafe-temp-drinks.desc: Cafe, the 10 days of cafe-midday-temp-c: all drinks, iced drinks and hot drinks sold that day (Activity debrief). hot = total - iced.

lsrl.notes: Session 5 Scenario B (iced only). Residual plot curved: + at both ends, - in the middle. Prediction at 12 C is -14.4 (impossible); intercept -133.03.

st-marys-shifts.desc: St Mary's, 20 evening shifts: patients arriving, doctors on duty, mean wait of the patients seen that shift (Scenario B). The individuals are shifts.

lsrl.notes: Session 5 solo case (arrivals -> mean wait). Shift 10 (52, 41): predicted 36.3, residual +4.7. Shift 7 (46, 28): predicted 33.8, residual -5.8. 60 arrivals 39.6; 110 arrivals 60.5 (extrapolation). Residual plot: no pattern.

library-hours-items-central.desc: The 35 Central branch members of library-hours-central: hours in library buildings and items borrowed last year (Solo case). Same order as the registered hours.
library-hours-items-central.notes: Cluster: 5 members with 49-56 hours and 2-6 items (study-space users).

oakfield-distance-time-12.desc: 12 of the 20 Oakfield students (times from oakfield-commute-20) with distance from school (Homework B).

lsrl.notes: Session 5 homework B. (6.8,38): predicted 26.7, residual +11.3. (4.2,14): predicted 16.6, residual -2.6. 5 km 19.7; 20 km 78.1 (extrapolation).

cafe-spring-mornings-5.desc: Five spring mornings: temperature at 8 am and hot drinks sold 7-10 am (Homework D, r by hand). x mean 15, s 5; y mean 150, s 20; sum of z-products -3.75; r = -0.9375.

lsrl.notes: Session 5 homework C, formula-sheet route: b = r*sy/sx = -0.9375*20/5 = -3.75; a = 150 - (-3.75)(15) = 206.25. 10 C: 168.8. (19,125): predicted 135.0, residual -10.0.

library-branches-18.desc: 18 library branches: public computers, weekly visits, residents served in thousands (Homework E, the confounding variable).

lsrl.notes: Session 5 homework E (residents -> visits). Branch (24, 1090): predicted 904.6, residual +185.4. Branch (37, 1160): predicted 1399.9, residual -239.9.

library-age-items-20.desc: 20 library members: age and items borrowed last year, U-shaped (Homework F1).

cafe-machine-warmup.desc: Cafe coffee machine warming up: minutes since switched on and water temperature (Homework F2).

lsrl.notes: Session 5 homework D. Residual signs: 3 negative, 8 positive, 3 negative (curved).

s04-synthetic-panels.desc: Synthetic scatterplots drawn in Session 4 figures (exact-r generator, seeded). x and y have no units.

s05-theory-abstract.desc: Made-up illustrations in the Session 5 theory section and figure s05-theory-residual-plots. No context.

linear_panel.note: residual plot with no pattern (figure only)

s05-reversing-cards.desc: Reversing Interpretations activity: Lincoln High students given by distance and residual, using yhat = 8.762 + 2.019x. Observed = predicted + residual.

lincoln-sampling-plans.desc: Lincoln High, N = 1,842 on the alphabetical school roll: home areas (from the office's address records, a census), tutor groups, and the five sampling plans of Scenario A, n about 120.

tutor_groups.arrangement: mixed: each group a mix of all three home areas

A.how: roll numbered 0001-1842; random number generator; repeats ignored (without replacement)

E.how: first 120 students through the main gate on Monday

sampling-methods-tool-population.desc: The simulated Lincoln High inside the Sampling Methods tool (build/fragments/sampling-methods.html). Fixed by seed 20260929 (mulberry32). Journey time = round(area mean + area sd * N(0,1)), floored at the area minimum. The school's real journey times are not known; these are simulated.

repeated_sampling_4000_draws.note: SD of the sample means, Node unit test, seed 99

st-marys-reminders-records.desc: St Mary's outpatients (Scenario B): 400 of last year's 9,600 outpatients selected with a random number generator; from the records, whether each had signed up for text reminders, whether they missed the appointment, and how it was booked. Retrospective observational study.
st-marys-reminders-records.notes: Only the margins above are shown in the session. One joint table consistent with them: self-booked signed up 7/140 missed, self-booked not 3/60, hospital-booked signed up 5/20, hospital-booked not 45/180; it is not quoted.

s06-theory-abstract.desc: Made-up illustrations in the Session 6 theory section and figure s06-theory-four-methods. No context.

srs_four.not_srs: coin toss between AB and CD: each individual 1/2, only 2 samples possible

hospital-network-sampling-hw.desc: Homework Part B: the Session 1 hospital network, 12,400 patients discharged last year from six hospitals; five survey plans.

plans.R: cluster, 3 of 124 wards (100 patients per ward on average)
plans.S: systematic, random start 1-41 then every 41st: 303 for starts 1-18, 302 for 19-41
plans.T: link on the discharge letter: volunteers, not random

cafe-loyalty-members.desc: Solo case: the cafe's 1,260 loyalty-card members, 504 using the app and 756 a paper card; 40 of each chosen with a random number generator (stratified by card type).

oakfield-roll-900.desc: Homework Part F: Oakfield School has 900 students; a random sample of 60, and 12 volunteers from one Year 8 class of 30.

lincoln-bus-survey-bias.desc: Scenario A: Lincoln High, N = 1,842. Bus-pass census gives the parameter; four earlier estimates of the proportion who travel mainly by bus, each checked against it; the late-bus wording split.

late_bus_wording.sample: new SRS of 120, split at random 60/60

sampling-bias-tool-population.desc: The simulated Lincoln High inside the Sampling Bias tool (build/fragments/sampling-bias.html). Seed 20261001 (mulberry32). Bus users fixed by area (85/316/250 = 651); 130 of the 651 use the main gate, the other 521 the side bus bay; all 1,191 non-bus users use the main gate.

model.gate: SRS of n from the 1,321 main-gate users (130 bus): centre 130/1321 = 0.0984
model.newsletter: first n replies; exponential reply times, rate 3 for bus users and 1 for others (successive weighted sampling)
model.phone: SRS of n phoned; answer probability 0.4 (bus) or 0.9 (others); data = those who answered; with 0.9 for both the method is unbiased

repeated_sampling_4000_draws.note: Node unit test, seeds 1030/1120/1480; centre and SD of the sample proportions

st-marys-reminder-experiment.desc: Scenario B: next month's 800 St Mary's outpatients, randomized block design by booking method; text reminder the day before or no text; response: missed the appointment. Continues st-marys-reminders-records (Session 6).

significance_check.statement: statistically significant (the session states it; the calculation is Sessions 15-16)

riverside-hand-cream.desc: Solo case: 30 Riverside nurse volunteers, matched pairs (two hands per nurse), coin decides which hand gets the new cream, placebo cream on the other; double-blind; dryness scored 0-10 by a specialist.

s07-theory-abstract.desc: Made-up illustrations in the Session 7 theory section and figure s07-theory-bias-variability. No context.

hospital-network-bias-hw.desc: Homework Part B: the hospital network's 12,400 discharged patients; parameter: proportion who would recommend their hospital. Plans and biases.

B3_email.direction: too low (over-75s most likely to recommend)

oakfield-reading-experiment-hw.desc: Homework Part C: 48 Oakfield Year 7 students, paper or tablet, 20-question comprehension quiz (Session 6 card O1). Block by reading age: 20 above their age, 28 not.

library-display-pairs-hw.desc: Homework Part D: the 18 branches of library-branches-18, paired by weekly visits for a matched pairs design (display of new books at the entrance, 8 weeks).

cafe-tables-coin-hw.desc: Homework Part E: 40 spring days, a coin at opening decides tables outside; mean takings higher on table days, statistically significant (stated, not computed: no takings data are given).

lincoln-travel-register.desc: Scenario A: Lincoln High travel register, a census of all 1,842 students: home area x main travel mode. The Bus column is Session 7's bus-pass census (lincoln-bus-survey-bias). Conditional relative frequencies to 3 dp from the counts.

hospital-waits-two-way.desc: Activity (Quiz-Quiz-Trade): the registered Session 3 waits (wait-st-marys, wait-riverside) grouped as under 20 min, 20 to 39 min, 40 min or more. Derived, not new data.

cafe-loyalty-visit-time.desc: Activity trade round: the cafe's 1,260 loyalty members (cafe-loyalty-members, Session 6: 504 app, 756 paper) by usual visit time from the till.

library-formats-solo.desc: Solo case: random sample of 250 members of the Central and Westside branches by borrowing format. Identical conditional relative frequencies (no association). P(both) estimate 75/250 = 0.300.

oakfield-lunch-hw.desc: Homework Part B: random sample of 200 Oakfield students from Years 7, 9 and 11, by usual lunch.

hospital-recommend-hw.desc: Homework Part C mosaic: the Session 1 hospital survey's 300 patients (hospital counts 84/71/52/45/30/18) by whether they would recommend their hospital.

stmarys-overbooking.desc: Scenario B: one St Mary's clinic, 10 slots per session; 100 of 1,000 appointments missed since texts began, so P(miss) estimated 0.10; proposal to book 11. Hand simulation: 20 trials of 11 digits (0 = misses), Python random.Random(seed).
stmarys-overbooking.figure_long_runs: figures/s08-stmarys-running: five runs of 10,000 with Python random.Random(911..955); ends 0.3134, 0.3211, 0.3198, 0.3145, 0.3126

overbooking-tool-model.desc: The Overbooking Simulation tool (build/fragments/overbooking-simulation.html). mulberry32, seeded from the clock at open. p = 0.10: one digit per patient, 0 = misses. p = 0.155: three-digit number 000-999, 000-154 = misses. Booked 10/11/12 into 10 slots. Opens with one run of 20 trials at 11 booked, p = 0.10. Max 20,000 trials per run.

cafe-sleeves-hw.desc: Homework Part D: 1 in 5 scratch sleeves wins; 4 coffees; P(at least one win). Digits 0,1 = win.

s08-theory-abstract.desc: Made-up illustrations in the Session 8 theory section. No context.
